title: Kristiansten Fortress
scope: Standing Kristiansten Fortress exterior, including the Donjon, central bastioned ramparts, Commandant’s residence and connected washhouse, and nearby Haubitzmagasinet.
limitations: Bastion crest and backfill levels and the Donjon’s section are interpreted from the map, terrain and exterior photographs. The model covers the principal group and preserves the outline of the angular fort. Interiors and detached equipment are outside the model.
